implementedRequests.peerAvailability: Authoritative who_online and separate realtime presence frames; live map drives DM lists/headers and member views. Unknown is not Online; Invisible is offline to peers.
implementedRequests.unreadAndMentions: Authenticated channel unread/mention snapshots, server mapping, realtime compact/full deduplication, read synchronization and late-response protection; Home/server/channel indicators.
implementedRequests.mentionPresentation: Native named user/role/channel links, own-mention highlight, own-mentions inbox, and eligible foreground in-app notice with native message destination. Not APNs push. Unknown unloaded role/channel names remain explicit until server context is available.
implementedRequests.membersAndRoles: Authorized server member pagination/search and preferred role-assignment RPC; highest eligible role colours/gradients. This is not an unrestricted global account directory.
implementedRequests.callParticipants: Actual reported voice memberships with mute/deafen/sharing state; unknown participants are not invented.
implementedRequests.channelTypesAndPosting: Channel type/private/read-only/rules/thread/voice/forum indicators and local posting/feature permission checks. Text/reply/media, reactions, polls and pins have applicable gates; RLS remains authoritative. External permission changes require refreshed snapshots, and server anti-abuse rules are not comprehensively reproduced.
implementedRequests.accountBackground: Read-only own user_prefs.prefs theme/colour/intensity and scoped server theme support. No arbitrary browser CSS/image-wallpaper import.

nativeUnitTests.scope: Synthetic native unit tests. Subsequent app edits affect UI permission gates, navigation restoration and decorative-background hit testing; core source remains the tested revision.

runtimeWarnings: Adding '_UIReparentingView' as a subview of UIHostingController.view is not supported and may result in a broken view hierarchy. Add your view above UIHostingController.view in a common superview or insert it into your SwiftUI content in a UIViewRepresentable instead.

nativeUIFlows.coverageBasis: Seven passing cases on each phone and six on iPad in confirmation; final iPad Back, notice destination and single-center channel switch all pass. Merged coverage across runs, not one clean complete-matrix invocation.
nativeUIFlows.initialFailures: Inbox DEBUG view initially bypassed the authoritative fixture feed. iPad direct channel switching remained blocked by an oversized decorative gradient crossing the sidebar. Early selector/plain-button theories and their provisional masks were rejected and removed.
nativeUIFlows.actualHitFix: Both NativeChatBackground branches now disable hit testing. The unmodified channel-button row activates on the first center tap after a read-only conversation was opened.
nativeUIFlows.runtimeQualification: Photos runs record UIKit _UIReparentingView warnings. The Pro Max photo case passed but recorded1415.646seconds; this is not a latency/performance acceptance result. No physical-device test.

warnings: Existing pinned LiveKit E2EEOptions deprecation; no encryption migration in this change.

keychainEvidence.scope: SessionVault source is unchanged; Models has new message metadata. Current exact Simulator package independently launched through session restoration into Welcome without an error.

verificationLimits.securityScope: Source, protocol, package and hash checks are bounded evidence, not a comprehensive malware audit or a guarantee about server/dependency behavior.
